description: Nosis is a lightweight personal agent runtime: per-session execution boundaries with OS-level sandboxing, computer use, a full built-in toolset, Skill / Plugin / MCP extensions, one runtime shared by GUI and TUI, and file-persisted sessions, plans, and memory.
